title: Product Record Schema
description: Shared data contract for the Product Intelligence pipeline. Do not modify after creation.

source_doc.description: Filename of the source document this record was extracted from

fields.description: Extracted product attributes. Keys are field names (e.g. name, dimensions, material, weight, rating).

value.description: The extracted value for this field (any type)

source.description: Whether this value was directly extracted or inferred

source_location.description: Page number or section string where this value was found

reasoning.description: Short explanation of how this value was extracted

conflicts.description: Any conflicting values found across sections of the same document

source_doc.description: Document where the conflict was found

resolved.description: Whether this conflict has been resolved
